name: angst
quote: Your generation had it so easy.
description: Persistent anxiety from a negative perception about the human condition or the state of the world in general.
perceptions: The world is messed up, and so are people.
I'm supposed to be doing something to make things better.
I don't know what to do.
examples: The culture war isn't going your way.

guidance.description: What It Means to Feel 'Angsty' and How to Cope

commentaries.quote: Angst creates a weight on one’s shoulders and causes a certain state of mind that is confused, angry, and scared, all at once.
Anyone not wanting to sink in the wretchedness of the finite is obliged in the most profound sense to struggle with the infinite.

I think there is too much wrong with the world to ever get too relaxed and happy. The more natural state, and the better one, I think, is one of some anxiety and tension over man’s plight in this mysterious universe.
Angst is an occupational hazard of writing, but that doesn't make it necessary or desirable. It's like saying you're a poor runner if you don't suffer knee injuries.
